definition: Water entering defined treatment boundary
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Influent is treatment feed; not automatically total treated product or GRI withdrawal.

definition: Water exiting treatment as product water
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Product water must be measured at specified outlet; not environmental discharge.

definition: Share of influent converted to treated output
formula_description: Sum treated output m3 / sum influent m3 * 100 for reporting period
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Use ratio of period totals, not unweighted mean daily recovery. Check zero influent and reconcile flagged records.

definition: Volume supplied for reuse
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Reclaimed supply may differ from daily treated output due to storage or other inputs; do not equate to freshwater saved.

definition: Water delivered at customer-end meter
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect

definition: Change in freshwater withdrawal under comparable service
formula_description: Adjusted baseline freshwater withdrawal - actual freshwater withdrawal
validation_rule: Matched water demand and substitution proof
evidence_requirement: Baseline and actual freshwater meter evidence
baseline_inputs: Comparable service demand; baseline freshwater withdrawal; actual freshwater withdrawal
attribution_evidence: Source meter records and substitution evidence
claim_rule: Report scenario difference until validated; do not infer avoided withdrawal from reclaimed volume alone

definition: Withdrawal by GRI source and TDS class
formula_description: Sum qualifying withdrawal by source and water-stress class
validation_rule: Source categories; TDS; stress; ML conversion
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Require withdrawal source, stress classification, freshwater/other water by TDS; convert m3 to ML for GRI.

definition: Discharge to GRI destinations and quality classes
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Require actual discharge destination, receiving body, TDS category, water stress, priority substances and incidents.

definition: Water unavailable for ecosystem/community in period
formula_description: GRI-defined withdrawal minus GRI-defined discharge (if appropriate); disclose significant storage changes
validation_rule: Complete water balance and reporting boundary
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Withdrawal minus discharge only under GRI-compatible boundary and accounting; record significant storage changes; do not use influent minus effluent.

definition: Relative reduction in conductivity
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Compute only when inlet EC > 0 and both readings valid; EC removal is not pollutant compliance.

definition: Measured influent and treated water pH
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect

definition: Share of valid samples meeting applicable standards
formula_description: Samples meeting ALL applicable criteria / valid fully assessed samples * 100
validation_rule: Applicable limits; relevant parameters; valid sampling
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Specify all applicable limits and sample coverage; only valid tested samples in denominator.

definition: Confirmed discharge-limit exceedance occasions
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Count confirmed incidents, not individual exceedance readings unless incident definition specifies this.

definition: Purchased electricity within defined facility boundary
validation_rule: Meter coverage; other energy sources separately
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Electricity is one component of organizational energy use; kWh to MJ conversion where required; verify GRI energy version.

definition: Electricity per treated water volume
validation_rule: Positive volume; consistent time and boundary
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Period SEC = sum(kWh)/sum(product m3); not arithmetic average of daily SEC. Electricity-only intensity, not total energy intensity.

definition: Expected electricity under comparable baseline
formula_description: Actual treated volume * adjusted baseline SEC
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
baseline_method: Historical conventional; matched comparator; or engineering scenario
baseline_inputs: Actual output; baseline SEC; salinity; target water quality; load; run-hours
attribution_evidence: AI control mode/time logs; comparable operating conditions; meter records; no simultaneous major upgrades
claim_rule: Planned SEC only gives difference against plan; do not claim AI savings without attribution

definition: Difference from defined baseline; not automatically AI-attributable
validation_rule: Separate planned target from verified conventional baseline
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
baseline_method: Historical conventional; matched comparator; or engineering scenario
baseline_inputs: Actual output; baseline SEC; salinity; target water quality; load; run-hours
attribution_evidence: AI control mode/time logs; comparable operating conditions; meter records; no simultaneous major upgrades
claim_rule: Planned SEC only gives difference against plan; do not claim AI savings without attribution

definition: Relative electricity difference from baseline
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
baseline_method: Historical conventional; matched comparator; or engineering scenario
baseline_inputs: Actual output; baseline SEC; salinity; target water quality; load; run-hours
attribution_evidence: AI control mode/time logs; comparable operating conditions; meter records; no simultaneous major upgrades
claim_rule: Planned SEC only gives difference against plan; do not claim AI savings without attribution

definition: Share of electricity supported by qualifying renewable sourcing
formula_description: Qualifying renewable electricity kWh / total electricity kWh * 100; no double counting
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Qualifying renewable electricity must be supported by metering/procurement instruments; distinguish from electricity generated.

definition: Indirect emissions attributable to purchased electricity
validation_rule: Factor gas coverage; location and year; client boundary
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Location-based and market-based separate; verify grid year, CO2 vs CO2e, contractual instruments and organizational control; factor not inferred for anonymous sites.

definition: Scope 2 emissions per treated output volume
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Label electricity-related Scope 2 intensity, not total GHG intensity; numerator must match gas scope and unit.

definition: Scenario baseline emissions less actual emissions
formula_description: (Adjusted baseline electricity * baseline EF - actual electricity * actual EF) / 1000; when factors comparable and matching units
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
baseline_inputs: Baseline and actual electricity; respective EFs; output; conditions
attribution_evidence: Baseline validation and control logs; emission factor provenance
claim_rule: Avoided emissions are separate from inventory; not automatically GRI 305-5 reductions or tradable credits

definition: Mass of each chemical used
formula_description: Sum verified chemical mass by type
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Dose_reported units unverified; require actual kg (active ingredient basis if relevant), concentration, density and volume/rate conversion where needed; do not aggregate different chemicals into a generic kg benefit without detail.

definition: Chemical mass per treated volume
formula_description: Verified mass of each chemical (kg) / treated product water m3
validation_rule: Do not sum unlike chemicals without breakdown
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Dose_reported units unverified; require actual kg (active ingredient basis if relevant), concentration, density and volume/rate conversion where needed; do not aggregate different chemicals into a generic kg benefit without detail.

definition: Chemical consumption difference under comparable baseline
formula_description: Adjusted baseline mass by chemical type - actual mass of same chemical type
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
ai_mechanism: Dosing and CIP optimisation (to verify control)
baseline_method: Adjusted comparable chemical consumption by chemical type
baseline_inputs: Baseline and actual kg by type; output; influent quality; target quality
attribution_evidence: Dosing controller logs; validated mass balance; quality compliance
claim_rule: Do not claim AI reduction from planned vs actual doses alone
implementation_note: Dose_reported units unverified; require actual kg (active ingredient basis if relevant), concentration, density and volume/rate conversion where needed; do not aggregate different chemicals into a generic kg benefit without detail.

definition: Document chemicals used or stored on site
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: AWS 1.3.6 is an inventory of potential pollution sources; chemical usage quantity alone does not satisfy requirement.

definition: Priority substances and compliance outcomes
evidence_requirement: Meter or source records; defined boundary
claim_rule: Measured operational KPI if data quality passes; not proof of AI effect
implementation_note: Water pollutant load = concentration (mg/L) * discharge volume (m3) / 1000 = kg; not chemical input mass. Needs pollutant-specific sampling.

definition: Incremental treated/recovered output relative to comparable conventional operation
formula_description: Actual recovered m3 - adjusted baseline recovered m3
validation_rule: Matched feedwater and quality; consistent product definition
reporting_output: Incremental recovered water, subject to attribution
evidence_requirement: Meters; baseline conditions; AI mode log
baseline_method: Matched historical conventional or comparator; engineering scenario only if clearly labelled
baseline_inputs: Baseline and actual under comparable water quality, treatment volume and operating conditions
attribution_evidence: AI on/off or control-mode logs plus matched operating conditions and independent meter/maintenance records
claim_rule: Only scenario difference unless a defensible baseline and attribution evidence exist
implementation_note: Recovery increase not equal to freshwater withdrawal avoided. Confirm control of RO recovery by AquaxGo.

definition: Difference in chemical mass under comparable treatment conditions

claim_rule: Only scenario difference unless a defensible baseline and attribution evidence exist

kpi_name: Reclaimed Water Share of Client Supply
definition: Reclaimed water used or supplied within the defined client water-supply boundary divided by total water supplied to the client.
formula_description: Reclaimed water supplied / total client water supply * 100
validation_rule: Total supply > 0; consistent metering boundary; no double counting
evidence_requirement: Client total water supply by source and metered reclaimed water
implementation_note: Not a GRI 303-3/4/5 direct disclosure.
